name: White's Thrush
extract: White's thrush (Zoothera aurea) is a member of the thrush family, Turdidae.  It was named after the English naturalist Gilbert White. The genus name Zoothera comes from the Ancient Greek zoon, "animal" and theras, "hunter". The specific aurea is from Latin aureus, "golden".
